fieldValues.title: A group PR the reviewer rejects has no one to fix it, so small red gates hold work and budget for days
fieldValues.summary: The reviewer rejects correctly, but no seat goes back to a rejected PR: the builder brief builds one NEW issue per run. On 2026-11-02 three of the four open third-party-ready PRs sat rejected on fixable gates: srs-rust#1540 (a cargo fmt diff, rejected 10-30 20:42), srs-rust#1541 (the site CLI reference not regenerated for the new --fields flag, rejected 10-30 22:42) and srs-rust#1487 (red Test and merge conflicts since 10-28). Open group PRs count against the budget, so the three also held 3 of the group's 10 slots.
evidence: clerk group-state wg:third-party-ready, 2026-11-02: 1 merged + 4 open of 10
fieldValues.body: Rework is the cheapest work in the system (the change is written and reviewed; only a gate is red) and it has no owner. A remedy: the builder's first step each run is its own group's rejected PRs, oldest first, before it picks a new issue.
